with expected as (
 select o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.order_total, cast(o.placed_at as timestamp) as ordered_at, c.country_code, cast(1 as bigint) as order_count
 from {{ source('demo', 'orders') }} o left join {{ source('demo', 'customers') }} c on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
), differences as (
 (select * from expected except all select * from {{ ref('fct_orders') }})
 union all
 (select * from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} except all select * from expected)
)
select * from differences

with expected as (
 select c.customer_id, c.country_code, c.signup_date,
 count(o.order_id) as order_count, coalesce(sum(o.order_total),0) as booked_amount
 from {{ source('demo', 'customers') }} c left join {{ source('demo', 'orders') }} o on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
 group by c.customer_id, c.country_code, c.signup_date
), differences as (
 (select * from expected except all select * from {{ ref('dim_customers') }})
 union all
 (select * from {{ ref('dim_customers') }} except all select * from expected)
)
select * from differences
